title: Ripple field

reference.source: Reference 28: an embroidered ripple ground with stitched picture patches and a prompt card, 2048×1152.
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: An embroidered green ground of concentric bands torn by one roughness field, stitched picture patches and yellow outline flowers torn by the same field, under a crisp prompt card.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 2048 × 1152 and every length scales with the canvas

band.does: Width of each light band before the edge is torn.

centerX.does: Ring center across the plate, from the middle.

centerY.does: Ring center down the plate, from the middle; the reference sits 68 px above it.

rough.does: Displacement every edge takes from the roughness field.

lump.does: Scale of the field's largest lumps; smaller values tear finer.

edgeSoft.does: Width of the tone ramp at a band edge; the reference's edges blend over about 2 px.

widthVar.does: How much the band width swells and thins along its length.

teeth.does: Amplitude of the fine tooth noise on every torn edge.

thread.does: Scales the thread: column width 3.5 px, stitch length 12 px, and the 4 px teeth on every torn edge.

comb.does: How far the satin columns of the yellow outline overshoot its edge.

lit.does: Contrast of each stitch's dark flank and lit center line, and the faint satin on the patch grounds; 0 is flat thread.

show.does: Share of stitches laid in the second thread color.

lineW.does: Width of the yellow line before it is torn.

patchScale.does: Scales the four picture patches about their centers.

spread.does: Moves the patches toward or away from the plate center.

corners.does: Corner radius scale: the card's 24 px and the patches' 12 px together; 5 makes pills.

typeCap.does: Cap height of the prompt line; the chip text follows at 0.73×.

typeWeight.does: Ink stroke added around the mono glyphs; 0 is JetBrains Mono Regular as loaded.

cardSoft.does: Resample blur on the whole card layer (edge, icon, chips, type), as the reference carries; 0 is crisp vector.

seed.does: Re-rolls the roughness field, the threads and the flower positions.

phase.does: Position along the loop: the bands move outward by one pitch per cycle.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: A light band 26 px wide: its edge wanders by 4.5 px σ with 4 px teeth, two flat greens and a 2 px ramp between.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: Band pitch 103.3 px from the center 68 px above the plate middle; the lumps along an edge run 20 to 27 px.

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Flower patch: 14 orange petal ellipses and a lilac disc laid as vertical capsule stitches, 3.5 px columns, 12 px long, red second thread on 19 % of stitches.

techniques.name: Type
techniques.implementation: The card: a 24 px corner, 88 px icon tile, 30 px cap JetBrains Mono with a 0.5 px stroke and a bright ringing halo, the layer softened by 0.35 px σ.

pass_order: pass 1, field: one roughness field at half resolution, three components upsampled with Catmull-Rom: two warp components (3-octave value noise with a 28 px base lump plus 4 px tooth noise) and one band-swell component; it displaces every torn edge

pass 2, patches: four crisp rounded rects; each motif is drawn flat twice (first and second thread), then laid as a bed of capsule stitches on a satin lattice (3.5 px columns, 12 px stitches end to end) following the motif's direction field, each stitch a dark flank, the thread color and a lit center line; 27 % of stitches take the second thread
pass 3, flowers: yellow outline flowers stroked flat on a full canvas, 10.5 px line, five petal loops around a ring

pass 4, pixels: per pixel, the warped position (field plus 0.7 px fray) samples the ring function with a 2.75 px edge ramp, the stitch beds at 30 % of the tear, and the flower canvas through a satin comb; a faint satin on the patch grounds; 1.2/255 grain per pixel

pass 5, card: the prompt card, icon, chips and buttons drawn on their own layer; the mono type gets a 0.5 px ink stroke and a bright resample halo; the layer is blurred by 0.35 px σ and composited on top

measured.plate: 2048×1152; ring center (1024, 508) by maximizing the radial profile contrast of the light-green fraction; band centers 126, 228, 333, 436, 540, 642, 745, 849, 953, 1056 px, pitch 103.3, offset 22.7
measured.bands: light band width 25 to 26 px between mean edges; edge radius jitter σ 4.2 to 4.6 px, peak to peak 16 px, no periodic peak in the edge autocorrelation; mean zero-crossing period 20 to 27 px along the arc; 1 to 2 px teeth on top
measured.greens: k-means on the ground: dark (16,141,71) 74 %, light (44,153,92) 26 %; whole-plate green share 78 %
measured.stitches: sunflower region autocorrelation x [0.79, 0.49, 0.32], y [0.85, 0.63, 0.46]: vertical threads about 3.5 px wide, stitches 10 to 12 px long; iris threads at 62°; the tooth noise on torn edges is set to 4 px, one thread wide
measured.edges: edge-radius spectrum along the 849 px ring (bands 80-40 … 3-2 px, log10 power): reference inner [4.39, 4.33, 3.52, 3.07, 2.84, 2.38, 2.08, 1.64], render [4.32, 3.54, 3.37, 3.09, 2.94, 2.46, 2.04, 1.79]: a red-noise profile with no peak at 20 to 27 px, so no sawtooth term was added
measured.type: reference glyph stems 4 to 5 px (run-length median 5), core (53,53,75), bulk 64 to 80 lum; 14 % of the type patch sits above 240 lum, a bright ringing halo around the glyphs, reproduced as an unsharp term on the type alpha
measured.flowers: yellow (237,171,31); line half-width 5.0 px by distance transform (10 to 11 px wide); the large flower spans 252 px centered at (1096, 329); five petal loops around a ring
measured.card: (461,463) to (1586,691), 1126×229, centered on the plate, corner radius 22 to 27 px, fill (238,237,230); icon tile 88 px periwinkle (129,137,199) at +22,+18 with a 55 px light-blue (183,221,234) bloom and a navy (54,64,93) mark; prompt cap height 30 px in (58,60,83) starting at +143; row two at +137: 77 px chip buttons (220,219,216), chip text cap 22 px; send button 75 px periwinkle 19 px from the right edge

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Field green palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The benchmark sets the card copy to the reference wording so the type patches compare the same glyphs. Motifs are the engine's own, so the stitched patch compares color shares, not drawing. The first flower sits at the reference flower's center so its rect compares like with like.

limits: The reference is a resampled JPEG: its band edges blend over 2 to 3 px and its dark green (lum 95.7) straddles a 16-bin histogram boundary, so the ripple-ground contrast and card-edge histogram sit near 0.96 to 0.97 even with a 2.75 px edge ramp and 1.2/255 grain.

The patch motifs are the engine's own drawings laid as stitches, so the stitched-patch rect compares thread-color shares and texture statistics, not the figure; its histogram sits near 0.94 and its navy color near 0.93.

The prompt type is JetBrains Mono Regular with a 0.5 px ink stroke, a bright ringing halo and a 0.35 px σ layer blur standing in for the reference's resampled glyphs; the type patch's histogram sits near 0.86.

The yellow flowers after the first are seeded away from the patches, so the outline-flower rect scores only the first flower, drawn at the reference flower's center; its histogram sits near 0.84 from the JPEG edge blend.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
